Listing notes: Philadelphia Water Department serves the whole city with water and sewer, so no service-area layer is used; the sewersheds layer returned nothing for this area.

Key findings

  • 0.8 of 4.0 acres (19.9%) is buildable at the 15% slope limit; 2.8 acres if 25% slopes are accepted.
  • No contiguous buildable patch of 0.25 acres or more.
  • Constraints removing area: steep 2.9 ac, setback 1.1 ac.
  • Winter sun on the buildable ground averages 8.1 h of a possible 8.5 h on Dec 21 (terrain shading only; trees not modelled).
  • Winter solar index on buildable ground is 1.06 (1.0 = flat open ground; south slopes exceed 1, north slopes fall below).
  • 49.0% of the property faces south-east to south-west or is flat.
  • 0.2 acres are garden-grade ground (gentle, sunny, dry soil), 2.2 acres suit orchards or terraces and 0.7 acres pasture. 1.6 acres of that lie outside the buildable area, so they are not lost to the building analysis.
  • USDA rates 0.2 acres as prime farmland soil and 0.8 acres as farmland of statewide importance.
  • Usable for building, growing or grazing combined: 3.1 acres (78.1%).
  • Mapped tree canopy covers 55.9% of the property; 0.4 acres of buildable and 1.4 acres of growing ground are under trees today.
  • 13.6 acres of neighbouring land drains onto the property; about 270 ft of concentrated flow paths cross it.
  • 100.0% of the soils are hydrologic group A/B (infiltrate well); hydric soils 0.0 ac.
  • Zoning: None ().
  • Road frontage: PORT ROYAL AVE 362 ft.
  • 2 existing structures on the parcels (see table).
